summary: Comprehensive backend test for InvoiceFlow API. All 25 tests passed (100%). Covered auth (login/me/wrong password/cookies), invoice CRUD + full workflow (8-stage advance, GRN validation, return-to-vendor, resubmit, PAID terminal state), attachments upload/download with token-auth file route, analytics (summary, stage-tat, vendors, CSV export, stuck), digest with no RESEND_API_KEY, and unauthenticated 401 enforcement on protected endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS middleware is added AFTER include_router; FastAPI applies it correctly because it wraps the app at request time, but conventionally middleware should be added before include_router for clarity.
allow_origins defaults to '*' AND allow_credentials=True is an invalid CORS combination per spec — browsers will reject. Should default to specific origin(s) when credentials are enabled.
_set_auth_cookies uses secure=False — fine for testing but for production behind HTTPS should be True. Consider env-driven flag.
No brute-force lockout implemented (mentioned in playbook guidance). Currently any number of wrong-password attempts allowed.
@app.on_event is deprecated in FastAPI; should migrate to lifespan handlers.
STAGE_LABELS dict missing key handling: analytics_summary uses distribution[status] fallback to RECEIVED — could mask data integrity issues.
test_credentials: admin@stores.com / admin123 (works). All seeded role users present.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed invoices (vendor names: TEST_Vendor_Acme, TEST_Vendor_Beta, TEST_Vendor_Return, TEST_Vendor_Attach). Not cleaned up — minor leftover data in dev DB only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints verified working. test_invoiceflow.py is the regression suite — re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_invoiceflow.py -v. If RESEND_API_KEY is later added, the digest test will still pass because it only asserts sent=False when no stuck invoices exist; consider adding a positive email path test once stuck data exists (>3 days old). Object storage worked correctly in this run; tests would skip gracefully on 503.
